=== chunk 0 | Configuration reference | location - | 19 tokens ===
--- context ---
Configuration reference
--- text ---
The controller reads `config.toml` at startup. Unknown keys are rejected.

=== chunk 1 | Configuration reference > Settings | location - | 84 tokens ===
--- context ---
Configuration reference
Settings
--- text ---
| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| listen_port | integer | 7070 | TCP port for the control API |
| heartbeat_seconds | integer | 15 | Interval between widget heartbeats |
| max_widgets | integer | 256 | Upper bound on registered widgets |
| log_format | string | json | Either json or text |

=== chunk 2 | Configuration reference > Example | location - | 35 tokens ===
--- context ---
Configuration reference
Example
--- text ---
```toml
listen_port = 7070
heartbeat_seconds = 10
max_widgets = 512
log_format = "json"
```
